fatal_flaws: No fatal flaws. Fig 1 is static speed-vs-acceleration envelopes rather than field paths; Fig 2C bars lack uncertainty; Figs 2 and 3B repeat the cross-position EU message.

top_changes: Turn the day-3 tiebreak into a decision-grade rule: explicit pick-gap threshold, break-even and observed error rate with interval; show Fig 4B as that rule with cost of a wrong call.
Add per-receiver SOE split by man/zone and slot/wide for named GO/HOLD receivers with cell n in the text; put the 0.43, 0.28 and 0.53-0.62 reliability figures in one small table.
Tighten: single-unit lede (inches of SOE per sd), drop physics paragraph to one sentence, move Robustness appendix to README, add a 'what flips each name' paragraph and 2-3 more GO/HOLD names.
judge-football.justification: Usable 8.3: concrete drill change, priced day-3 tiebreak, named GO/HOLD list with flip conditions and decision date; tiebreak unproven (p=0.12, 20 pairs from 16 receivers), pick-gap threshold not stated as a rule. Difficulty 8.8: reps per player, reliability/shrinkage, pick baseline, survivorship, tracked-40 laser caveat, sampled-snap limits; man/zone and slot/wide tables only gestured at, injuries only as games-played filters. Unique 8.6: drill-cut-to-same-route transfer reframing, entry-speed mismatch 6.9 vs 4.7 yd/s; core result is a null. Terminology 8.0: correct usage; physics paragraph pedantic, lede mixes units, Kraft as TE in a WR table.

top_changes: Run formal TOST against +-3 in and report smallest significant margin; add receiver-clustered permutation p for the day-3 gain.
Pre-register GO/HOLD rule and back-test leave-one-class-out on 2023 and 2024 shortlists with hit rate interval vs pick-only baseline; show 2026 list under draft-class folds.
Make verify.py recompute SOE from raw NGS in player_season_stats; add sensitivity table for shrinkage, 8-break and 100-route thresholds.
judge-datascience.justification: All 12 verify.py checks reproduce in under a second from shipped intermediate CSVs, so upstream SOE construction only partly independent. Strong design: no-tracking baseline, leave-one-class-out, year-standardized drills, shrinkage, MDE; equivalence inside +-3 not shown. Weak: day-3 evidence 20 pairs/16 receivers, gain halves under draft-class folds, shuffle p=0.12, forking-path risk, 2026 labels rest on a lean result.

top_changes: Rewrite the Break G definition paragraph: open with one coach-repeatable sentence; delete the force/mass derivation, the 57% body weight line and the 4%-of-a-cut aside.

Split 'What to do' item 3; move 17.2/9.9-inch payoff, 64-of-100 break-even, 0.2-inch/0.03-catch cost and TE note to a table or day-3 section; cut 'Two checks on the split', Holm p, shrinkage-rebuild interval and MDE to appendix; body under ~1,700 words.
Fix lede and hedging: single unit (inches of separation), state day-3 rule once with one confidence label, trim the 16-name null table to ~6 rows.

judge-writeup.justification: check.py passes (1,977 words, 5 figures, 3 tables). Finding-bearing title, ~80-word lede, finalist structure, meaningful headings. Weak: density and muddy middle (physics opening, run-on item 3, too much machinery for a coach), hedging on both sides (suggestive/Lean/p=0.12), mixed units in lede, thin 'why now', 16-row table for a null.

top_changes: Drop Fig 2A (pooled r=0.02 repeats Fig 1 headline); fold 0.43 into an annotation on Fig 1A; keep 2B equivalence forest with TOST wording; frees a slot.
Make Fig 3 a multi-player small-multiple panel (4-6 receivers: Washington, Douglas, Iosivas, Lambert-Smith, Smith) with Break G and entry speed printed and a league-median ghost path.
Raise tick/annotation text to >=9 pt in Figs 4 and 5; relabel Fig 4B plainly; add decision date and flip marker to Fig 5A; swap HOLD pink for orange with a distinct marker shape.
judge-viz.justification: Five figures plus ~3 tables within limit; one coherent story. Figs 1 and 3 tracking-native. Uncertainty shown throughout (90% intervals, +-3 in band, detection-chance sizes, cell n). Overlap: Fig 1B vs 3C, Fig 2A vs Fig 1. Weak: small tick/cell-n text, Fig 5A legend crowding, Fig 4B cramped axis label, shared axis mixes drill r and speed 0.43 estimands, HOLD pink near grey, Fig 4A pairs double-count receivers.
